searchDocs.title: State​
searchDocs.content: </> interface State { Position: Vector3 -- The current position of the spring. Target: Vector3 -- The target position the spring is moving towards. Velocity: Vector3 -- The current velocity of the spring. Mass: number-- The mass of the spring. Force: number-- The force applied to the spring. Damping: number-- The damping factor (friction) of the spring. Speed: number-- The simulation speed multiplier. Iterations: number-- The number of calculation iterations per update for stability. } Represents the current physical state and properties of the spring.

searchDocs.title: PartialState​
searchDocs.content: </> interface PartialState { Position: Vector3? -- Optional position override. Target: Vector3? -- Optional target override. Velocity: Vector3? -- Optional velocity override. Mass: number?-- Optional mass override. Force: number?-- Optional force override. Damping: number?-- Optional damping override. Speed: number?-- Optional speed multiplier override. Iterations: number?-- Optional iterations override. } A partial state object used for updating specific spring properties.

searchDocs.title: SpringObject​
searchDocs.content: </> interface SpringObject { Update: (deltaTime: number) → Vector3 -- Steps the simulation forward and returns the new position. ApplyImpulse: (force: Vector3 ) → ()-- Applies an instantaneous force to the spring's velocity. SetState: (state: PartialState) → ()-- Updates specific properties of the spring's state. GetState: () → State-- Returns a read-only copy of the current state. } The Spring object instance containing the methods to simulate and interact with the spring.

searchDocs.title: Spring()​
searchDocs.content: </> Spring( mass: number?,-- The mass of the spring (Default: 5) force: number?,-- The force/stiffness of the spring (Default: 50) damping: number?,-- The damping/friction (Default: 4) speed: number?,-- The speed multiplier (Default: 4) iteration: number?-- The number of iterations per update (Default: 8) ) → SpringObject Creates a new Spring instance.
